pages.title: Set up recense
pages.description: Choose which recense setups you need, from one machine to a hub with attached machines and agents, and let your agent set each one up with you.

pages.title: Set up recense on one machine
pages.description: Install the recense command, run a review server only this machine reaches, and add the review skills for your agents.

pages.title: Set up your own recense hub on Tailscale
pages.description: Run a recense hub on your own tailnet and pair your phone to it, to review agent work from your phone or other machines.

pages.title: Set up your own recense hub behind your own address
pages.description: Run a recense hub behind your own name and HTTPS reverse proxy, and pair your phone to it, instead of using Tailscale.

pages.title: Attach more of your machines to your hub
pages.description: Attach other machines to your hub, so their agents publish to one inbox and the feedback you send from any device reaches them.

pages.title: Set up your agents for recense
pages.description: Set up Claude Code, Codex or another coding agent with the review skills and optionally the MCP server, to publish and wait for your feedback.

pages.title: Develop recense from a checkout
pages.description: Install recense from a checkout of its source with pnpm install:local, and avoid running a build that agents can change.

pages.title: Update recense
pages.description: Update the package, server, agent skills, Claude Code plugin and phone app when a new recense version is out.

pages.title: Troubleshooting recense setup
pages.description: Find the error line recense prints during setup or update, why it happens, and how to fix it.

pages.title: Using recense
pages.description: Configure the recense command and publish a doc for review in day-to-day use.
